decision_rule: GO requires no observed false accepted edge and all 20 largest-component boundary checks to pass.
limitations: The 32+32 accepted-edge samples are deterministic rather than random.
A passed edge means the two rows appear to belong to one product family; it does not prove that every path inside the resulting component is correct.
No precision claim is made for unaudited stages or smaller components.

required_fail_closed_policy_changes.change: Remove standalone acceptance for two exact auxiliary images. Accept an auxiliary edge only with independent product-identity text corroboration; otherwise quarantine it.
Two perceptually matching auxiliary images are insufficient. Require a matched informative first image on both rows or independent product-identity text corroboration; otherwise quarantine.
An image key reused across distinct normalized product-identity signatures cannot provide corroboration and must be marked non-informative for graph edges.
Quarantine an exact-full-text group when its name/text is low-information and informative first product images disagree; do not let copied boilerplate override product-image contradiction.

results.note: Wilson intervals are descriptive only: deterministic samples and deliberately risky component boundaries are not random population samples.

review_method: Side-by-side review of public names/descriptions, first product images, at least one matched image position, and accepted edge provenance. No result used labels, predictions, scores, or partitions.

scope.selection: For each accepted stage, first 32 pairs in deterministic builder row order; components ordered by descending size. Each component checks the latest-stage union bridge and the highest-risk lowest-text-similarity internal edge.
